headline: Florence Pugh reveals Dunesday watch order
post:

Ticket pre-sales reportedly show Avengers: Doomsday outpacing Dune: Part Three, but both films have plenty of time to shine this holiday season. 🎬

headline: Exploring All 10 Of Wolverine's Children
post:
Hey X-Men fans! With Logan's long and violent history in Marvel's main universe, his past has repeatedly caught up with him through his lineage. According to Screen Rant, tracking down every single one of his offspring can be pretty tough since they arrived through clones, time travel, and hidden secrets.

From well-known heroes like Laura Kinney and Daken to lesser-known characters like Erista and the deadly Mongrels recruited by the Red Right Hand, Logan's children have constantly tested whether the rugged X-Man can build anything that lasts beyond violence. Some of these kids are even just as deadly, if not deadlier, than Wolverine himself!

headline: Sarah Gaunt targets Xavier's legacy
post:
Marvel has introduced a dark new mentor to the X-Men franchise following Professor X's departure. In Uncanny X-Men #38, the villainous Sarah Gaunt, also known as the Hag, sets up her own mansion and brainwashes young mutant runaways into a group called the Scavenged.

Gaunt reportedly aims to replace Charles Xavier by building a twisted school of her own. Meanwhile, Emma Frost has stepped up to found the new psychic school Graymatter Lane in X-Men United.

headline: Six Million Dollar Man toys before Star Wars
post:
Did you know that before a galaxy far, far away took over toy aisles, Kenner scored a massive hit with Steve Austin? According to ComicBook.com, the 1975 release of The Six Million Dollar Man action figure line put the company on the map. 

Fans couldn't get enough of the 12-inch figure featuring a telescoping "bionic eye" and a removable piece of rubber skin showing bionic parts underneath. The toy line eventually expanded to include vehicles, playsets, and characters like the Bionic Woman and Bionic Bigfoot.

Now, according to the same report, strong nostalgia has driven bidding for a near-mint carded Steve Austin up to $500 with nearly two weeks left at auction. 

Did you ever own any of these classic bionic toys?

#SixMillionDollarMan #KennerToys #StarWarsHistory
original_title: Before Star Wars, These Six Million Dollar Man Action Figures Were Kenner’s Biggest Hit

headline: Spider-Man debut comic sells for $109K
post:
Spider-Man's iconic debut issue recently pulled in a massive six-figure bid at a Heritage Auctions event. A copy of the famous Marvel comic with a 7.0 grading officially sold for $109,800.

While six figures is certainly huge, this final hammer price actually ended up being the lowest recent sale for a 7.0 graded copy compared to previous years.

How much would you pay to own a copy of Spider-Man’s first appearance?

#SpiderMan #MarvelComics #HeritageAuctions
original_title: The Spider-Man Comic Everyone Wants to Own Just Sold for $109K – and That Is Cheap Compared to Its Record-Breaking Sale 5 Years Ago
